title: Generalization as a robust performance property of learning-enabled dynamical systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.30431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: By focusing on algorithmic stability as a means of establishing out-of-sample bounds, we provide a system-theoretic interpretation of generalization in learning-enabled dynamical systems arising in data-driven optimization and feedback control approximation. Given two neighboring datasets, we specifically model sample replacement as an exogenous disturbance acting on a sensitivity system, while the incremental behavior of the data-dependent operator is encoded through an integral quadratic constraint. By relying on dissipativity arguments, we establish a matrix inequality-based certificate and a uniform stability bound that separates the one-sample sensitivity of the learned operator, and an algorithm-dependent dynamical gain. The latter can then be optimized, offering a tractable tool for certifying and comparing generalization capabilities of learning dynamics. translated_title: 泛化作为学习型动力系统的鲁棒性能性质
translated_abstract: 通过聚焦于算法稳定性作为建立样本外泛化界的手段，我们为数据驱动优化和反馈控制近似中产生的学习型动力系统的泛化提供了系统论层面的解释。给定两个相邻数据集，我们特别将样本替换建模为作用于灵敏度系统的外生扰动，同时通过积分二次约束对数据相关算子的增量行为进行编码。借助耗散性论证，我们建立了一个基于矩阵不等式的证书和一个一致稳定性界，该界将学习算子的单样本灵敏度与依赖于算法的动态增益分离开来。后者随后可以被优化，为认证和比较学习动力学的泛化能力提供了一个易于处理的工具。我们展示了我们的结果能够恢复梯度下降的经典结论。
tldr: 本文将泛化解释为学习型动力系统的一种鲁棒性能性质，通过耗散性理论建立了基于矩阵不等式的一致稳定性证书，将学习算子的单样本灵敏度与算法相关的动态增益分离，从而为认证和比较学习算法的泛化能力提供了可优化的系统论工具。
en_tdlr: This paper interprets generalization as a robust performance property of learning-enabled dynamical systems, establishing a matrix inequality-based uniform stability certificate via dissipativity theory that separates the one-sample sensitivity of the learned operator from an algorithm-dependent dynamical gain, providing an optimizable system-theoretic tool for certifying and comparing generalization capabilities of learning algorithms.
